title: Tesla posts its Cybercab Autonomy Subscription Agreement, requiring personal buyers to pay a mandatory $299/month on top of the vehicle's $29,990 purchase price (Fred Lambert/Electrek)
summary: Fred Lambert / Electrek: Tesla posts its Cybercab Autonomy Subscription Agreement, requiring personal buyers to pay a mandatory $299/month on top of the vehicle's $29,990 purchase price — Tesla has posted the agreement that comes with its $29,990 Cybercab, and it's even worse than the order page suggested.
